series: Hai chị em Thảo Nguyên – Thảo My và người bạn ăn xin
style: Cinematic high-quality 3D anime, natural child proportions, physically coherent depth, warm lighting, 16:9, 24fps, no on-image text
message: Lòng nhân ái, tôn trọng phẩm giá, chia sẻ đúng cách và tìm kiếm sự hỗ trợ an toàn từ người lớn đáng tin cậy.
dignity_rule: Khang is never framed as an object of pity: no poverty caricature, no exaggerated begging, no humiliating close-up. He is a child with dignity, hope and agency.
wardrobe_rule: Default wardrobe is used in all 12 main scenes. Dress wardrobe is only for extras (birthday, outing, promo). Do not let the model invent new clothes between contiguous same-day scenes. At school, only Khang changes into a uniform; face, hair and body stay locked.
text_rule: No AI-written Vietnamese (or any) text inside generated images. Titles, subtitles, name tags and the closing message are added in post with the motion package.
